A few things to know

Will choosing a price start a subscription?

No. This is an interactive preview. It does not create a subscription, start a trial, set an expiry or change your workspace.

Can the first-month offer stack with annual savings?

No. The proposed ₹499 offer is for the first paid month on a monthly plan, once per workspace. The annual plan is ₹9,990 paid upfront and has its own saving.

Does the free beta end after 14 days?

No. Your existing beta workspace has no expiry. The proposed 14-day no-card trial applies only to a future paid launch.
